item.title: CodePink launches China tour amid grand jury probe into Singham network funding
item.description: CodePink co-founder Medea Benjamin is leading a 12-day China tour focused on revolutionary history and socialist development, with ties to Singham.

item.title: United States replenishes missile stockpiles with major purchase
Democrats' anger over Ilhan Omar raid met with GOP reminder of past precedent
item.description: ICE raided Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home, sparking partisan debate over immigration fraud and the weaponization of federal agencies.

item.title: Letitia James' pledge for fair Cornell rape probe clashes with aide's quiet exit
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James faces recusal calls in the Cornell 7 case after voicing support for Jane Doe before the investigation.
